name: Miu
source: A girl of the forest people. She is poor at speaking but is very expressive. Lives a modest life while coexisting with the bugs in the forest. She harbors a strong wariness towards humans intruding in the forest, and will growl at them like a wild animal to threaten them. She is very innocent in the sense that once she believes something, she will never question it.
